title: Book as a guest with the airline card (no Stripe needed)
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/storefront/checkout-airline-card.e2e.ts. Needs AIRLINE_CARD_ENABLED=true (the .env.example value) and storefront_settings.airline_card_enabled_test switched on for the demo OTA (off for a new OTA). Test card 4111 1111 1111 1111 (stub); 4000 0000 0000 0002 is declined.

steps.title: Switch the airline card on (development only)
steps.body: The demo OTA has no staff member, so use SQL as `velexis_ota_app`: `psql postgres://velexis_ota_app:dev_ota@127.0.0.1:5432/velexis -c "UPDATE tenant_demo.storefront_settings SET airline_card_enabled_test = true, version = version + 1, updated_at = now()"`, then drop the 5-minute storefront cache: `redis-cli -a dev_redis --scan --pattern "t:*:test:sf:*" | xargs -r redis-cli -a dev_redis del`. On an OTA you own, use the OTA admin settings instead (it deletes the cache itself).
steps.expect: `GET /v1/storefront` now lists the airline-card payment method.

steps.title: Search and price
steps.body: Search Madrid → Paris, open an offer, choose a fare, continue to price.
steps.expect: Priced offer shown with total; `priced_offers` row.

steps.title: Checkout as guest
steps.body: Fill one traveller and the contact e-mail, accept the terms.

steps.title: Choose "Card, charged by the airline"
steps.body: The airline-card page opens with the airline's notice and price.
steps.expect: `POST …/payments {method: airline_card}`: checkout `pricing_mode = net` (no markup, no OTA fees), `payments` row provider `airline`, method `airline_card`.

steps.title: Type the card
steps.body: Type 4111 1111 1111 1111, any future expiry, CVC, holder.
steps.expect: After six digits `PATCH /v1/payments/{id}` with `{card: {brand, bin}}` re-quotes the airline card fee; totals update.

steps.title: Pay
steps.expect: `POST /api/v1/checkouts/{id}/airline-card-completion` → `201`; confirmation page with reference `VX…` and tickets. Booking `ticketed`, payment `captured` with `card_brand`, `card_bin`, `card_last4` only; cookie `__Host-vx_bt` (HttpOnly).

steps.title: Check e-mails and PDFs
steps.expect: `booking.confirmed` / `booking.ticketed` e-mails with the itinerary and e-ticket receipts attached; `booking_documents` rows `ready`; `notifications` rows `sent`.

steps.title: Declines and limits
steps.body: Repeat with 4000 0000 0000 0002 three times on one checkout.
steps.expect: `402 PAYMENT_DECLINED` twice, then `403 PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`; staff alert `staff.airline_card_alert`; Redis `t:<tenantId>:test:ac:chk:<chk>` = 3. No card number anywhere (DB, Redis, logs).
